title: Microbiologists
description: Investigate the growth, structure, development, and other characteristics of microscopic organisms, such as bacteria, algae, or fungi. Includes medical microbiologists who study the relationship between organisms and disease or the effects of antibiotics on microorganisms.

tasks.text: Isolate and maintain cultures of bacteria or other microorganisms in prescribed or developed media, controlling moisture, aeration, temperature, and nutrition.

dwas.name: Cultivate micro-organisms for study, testing, or medical preparations.
Prepare biological samples for testing or analysis.

tasks.text: Provide laboratory services for health departments, community environmental health programs, and physicians needing information for diagnosis and treatment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Biological sample analysis needs wet-lab execution

tasks.text: Monitor and perform tests on water, food, and the environment to detect harmful microorganisms or to obtain information about sources of pollution, contamination, or infection.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Monitoring requires sensors, sampling, field presence

dwas.name: Monitor environmental impacts of production or development activities.

emerging.task: Perform tests on water, food, and the environment to detect harmful microorganisms or to obtain information about sources of pollution, contamination, or infection and interpret the results.
emerging.original_task: Monitor and perform tests on water, food, and the environment to detect harmful microorganisms or to obtain information about sources of pollution, contamination, or infection.

tasks.text: Examine physiological, morphological, and cultural characteristics, using microscope, to identify and classify microorganisms in human, water, and food specimens.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Classification aided by vision; specimen handling human

dwas.name: Classify organisms based on their characteristics or behavior.

tasks.text: Supervise biological technologists and technicians and other scientists.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical supervision requires judgment and accountability

tasks.text: Use a variety of specialized equipment, such as electron microscopes, gas and high-pressure liquid chromatographs, electrophoresis units, thermocyclers, fluorescence-activated cell sorters, and phosphorimagers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on lab/field equipment operation with samples

tasks.text: Investigate the relationship between organisms and disease, including the control of epidemics and the effects of antibiotics on microorganisms.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Literature and data aided; lab work human

tasks.text: Prepare technical reports and recommendations, based upon research outcomes.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reports drafted; presentations need human delivery

dwas.name: Prepare scientific or technical reports or presentations.

tasks.text: Observe action of microorganisms upon living tissues of plants, higher animals, and other microorganisms, and on dead organic matter.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Examining live organisms needs hands-on lab work

dwas.name: Examine characteristics or behavior of living organisms.

tasks.text: Study growth, structure, development, and general characteristics of bacteria and other microorganisms to understand their relationship to human, plant, and animal health.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Analysis aided; bench experiments need human hands

dwas.name: Research microbiological or chemical processes or structures.

tasks.text: Study the structure and function of human, animal, and plant tissues, cells, pathogens, and toxins.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Analysis aided; bench experiments need human hands

dwas.name: Research microbiological or chemical processes or structures.

tasks.text: Develop new products and procedures for sterilization, food and pharmaceutical supply preservation, or microbial contamination detection.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids product development; prototyping and testing human

dwas.name: Develop new or advanced products or production methods.

tasks.text: Conduct chemical analyses of substances such as acids, alcohols, and enzymes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical analysis requires instruments and hands

tasks.text: Research use of bacteria and microorganisms to develop vitamins, antibiotics, amino acids, grain alcohol, sugars, and polymers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids product development; prototyping and testing human
